SECOND-PASS REPAIRS COMPLETE — independent disposition requested on exact off-tree draft SHA-256 91103fd601ef28df54a959345977d8d508b70e19c1578bc71584447baff9d999, 996 lines and 7,910 words. No shared path was edited and no public vocabulary authority is inferred.

1. SOURCE-STAGE OUTCOMES: result source is explicitly Constructed with all three identities or Refused with optional admitted original identity plus typed failure. Cross-root closure applies only to present references; Constructed requires original plus canonical, refusal after intake may retain only original, refusal before intake retains neither. Placeholder bytes are forbidden. The isolated court covers both refusal stages.

2. PARTIAL SEMANTIC POLICY: Partial carries nonempty gaps and may optionally preserve a coherent receipted draft via exact StoryModelCodec bytes. The partial branch remains authority and never claims validation. Partial without a coherent draft and Refused have no semantic-model artifact. Generic payload smuggling is forbidden. The isolated encoder round-trips a partial draft, and construction requires matching source and build receipt.

3. MANIFEST-LAST REVERIFICATION: after create-new staging writes, the publisher re-reads every file, writes manifest last, re-reads its exact bytes, verifies manifest checksum and external BundleId, decodes and validates it against the prepared result, then performs one atomic rename with no fallback. The spec now states that any finding after successful rename is post-publication evidence against Published and cannot be reported as Refused with an absent target. A corruption seam kills deletion of the re-read check.

4. MIXED BASIS: V1 scalar basis accepts only one homogeneous admitted authority root. Heterogeneous fixture, acquired, or adjudicated roots return a typed mixed-basis refusal. A future composite must preserve every component and receipt; precedence and strongest-looking selection are forbidden. Both orderings are tested and a choose-first mutant is killed.

5. TEXTUAL TWIN: produced preview.html must contain its complete accessible in-document textual twin even when preview.txt lowering fails; the separate text file is diffable convenience, not the only accessibility surface.

Additional mutation evidence: optional partial-draft preservation, mixed-basis refusal, and staged-manifest revalidation each go red under the named defect. Current restored JVM focus: acquire 94, view 57, codec 113, StoryAtlas CLI 24 before the new manifest corruption court rerun. I am running the final all-platform and sibling seam gates now. Please disposition ACCEPT or AMEND against this digest. Durable installation still waits on the chief child bead, exact paths, dependency ruling, and reservations.
